label: L=3, first copy step after <DEL> (re-input of first token), favoring y/1/q/v/f/j
explanation: Fires only in length-3 sequences at step t=4, the step after <DEL> where the model inputs its first output (orig 0) and outputs orig 1. (L==3)&(t==4) has recall 1.0 and mass recall 1.0 but only ~15% precision. Within that slot, selectivity depends on the first token: y (33% of mass, includes the max), 1, q, v, f, j dominate; restricting to these gives F1 ~0.6 and mass recall ~0.82. The second token (the one output at this step) also matters: s, r, w, g, f, p raise it and digits or letters like h, l, i, b tend to suppress it, but this effect is weak and adding it did not raise F1. Never fires in the original phase, on <DEL>, at other copy steps, or for L>=4. Activations are small (max 0.059).

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: L=3 & recall_idx=1 (+2.18), L=3 & t=4 (+2.18), t=4 & prev_tok=<DEL> (+2.18), t=4 & in_tok=j (+2.16), t=4 & in_tok=v (+2.10), t=4 & in_tok=1 (+2.10). Lower it: orig0=b (-1.68), orig2=h (-1.68), orig1=i (-1.66), orig0=i (-1.61).
